All verification complete. Every existence-grounding claim in the doc checks out against the repo — SCENARIO-024's ④/⑤ assertions pin 8/8 exactly as described, the "+1 pure-append delta" convention comment exists in that file, the ::before-accent=7 pins exist in fusion SCENARIO-004 and fission SCENARIO-023/025, root index.html has exactly 8 cards and 7 accent rules, the exact `#homeBtn` markup matches the fusion-pinned string, and both sibling suites measure 33/33 and 39/39 when run (confirming the doc's correction of the spec's stale 36/36). I also traced every hub-counting assertion in all 7 sibling test files: the "only SCENARIO-024 ④⑤ changes" scope in AC-03 is closure-complete.

The blocking defects are confined to AC-05's frozen golden-value contract (echoed once in AC-08): four rows are unsatisfiable by any correct implementation of the mandated formulas — doppler1pz(0.1)=1.00504 is the transverse factor γ while the spec's own formula and ch07's signed slider need the longitudinal 1.10554; the rvK triple mixes mass/period units (Mj/days vs Mj/years vs M⊕/years) so one function cannot pass all three calls; lambdaObs(14.44, 121.567) must be 1876.99 nm by the doc's own λobs=(1+z)λemit, not the pinned 1882±1; and balmerLine 656.3±0.1 is unreachable by vacuum Rydberg (656.46/656.11) without the unstated air-wavelength convention. These would stall the phase2 golden suite in permanent RED.
